notes.title: Hotfix Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders,

We are excited to announce the latest hotfix update for Steel Graves, now live on Steam! This patch addresses several bugs reported by our community, improves game stability, and adjusts balance elements to deliver a smoother and more intense combat experience.

Hotfix Highlights:

 Major bug fixes that were affecting gameplay.
 Performance optimizations to reduce loading times and enhance responsiveness.
 Balance adjustments to make battles more strategic and dynamic.
 Visual enhancements and UI tweaks to boost immersion.


Grab your controllers and keep the battle alive!

The Steel Graves Team

Do not hesitate to give us feedback on the Discord
To not miss anything go to Twitter

notes.title: #4 Alpha 1.4 Update
notes.notes:
After several weeks of development, I'm happy to announce a major update will be released early next week.


Update #4 "Alpha 1.4"
This major update has been guided by the players who contacted me (thank you very much).
Changelog:

Add Human and Alien tutorials
New "Mission" game mode
Added mechanized armor for humans
Bugfix
Finalization of the English translation
Optimization
Balancing




Do not hesitate to go to the Discord for more information

To not miss anything go to Twitter

notes.title: #3 Alpha 1.3 Update
notes.notes:
Update
New content

 Added special attack to HammerBug
 Added special attack to Creepy
 Addition of a limit to the superposition of sounds
 Addition of nicknames above the head
 Addition of a spectator mode
 Added 25 waves to survival mode. Which makes a total of 50 waves


Change

 Overhaul of the composition of the Alien squads
 The foundations of humans can be turned
 Compatibility with QWERTY keyboards
 Changed the respawn process
 Performance optimization in multiplayer


Bugfix

 The close button of the quick tutorial correctly closes the menu
 The doors open and close correctly
